rationale: This mutation resolves the -$10,999 cash deficit by implementing synchronous land-labor scaling to 18-20 plots by Day 15, eliminating workforce idling while enforcing strict 2.0x payroll liquidity gating. It maximizes multi-harvest compounding by sustaining hyper-fertilized Strawberries through Day 24-25 and introduces an atomic in-situ harvest-and-water pipeline to eradicate growth-freezing dry intervals. Furthermore, it protects realized margins by establishing a rigid 0.82x liquidation price floor, desensitizing Oracle glut triggers to >= 0.55, enforcing crop-growth duration feasibility on Town Shop contracts, and purging phantom wheat reserves.
